_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); analog semiconductor signals; the listing and short-history bounds rules (AVGO)

pit_profile.why: Avago: 'We are a leading designer, developer and global supplier of a broad range of semiconductor devices with a focus on analog III-V based products and complex digital and mixed signal complementary metal oxide semiconductor based devices', 'We have four reportable segments: wireless communications, wired infrastructure, enterprise storage and industrial & other, which align with our principal target markets', and 'We operate a primarily outsourced manufacturing business model' (its own FY2014 10-K); 'The global semiconductor market is highly competitive', and 'We operate in the highly cyclical semiconductor industry, which is subject to significant downturns': a cyclical and competitive risk, not an obsolescence one

classification.quality_note: Avago: 'We are a leading designer, developer and global supplier of a broad range of semiconductor devices with a focus on analog III-V based products and complex digital and mixed signal complementary metal oxide semiconductor based devices', 'We have four reportable segments: wireless communications, wired infrastructure, enterprise storage and industrial & other, which align with our principal target markets', and 'We operate a primarily outsourced manufacturing business model' (its own FY2014 10-K); 'The global semiconductor market is highly competitive', and 'We operate in the highly cyclical semiconductor industry, which is subject to significant downturns': a cyclical and competitive risk, not an obsolescence one. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; +434% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +0.24; conservative 2yr -58%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -2.7%/yr (worst year FY08-FY13 ex-FY09, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +33.0%/yr (Q3 FY15 guide YoY + margin + buyback); P/E at its 5.6-yr ex-FY09 ex-FY14 median

BULL.desc: EPS +53.1%/yr (FY08-FY13 ex-FY09 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +155.0%/yr (best 2-yr run FY08-FY13 ex-FY09, at least BULL); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: AVGO (retrospective, 2015-06-12) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B infx (82.9% downside to Bear $24.01 / -38.9% upside to Bull $85.84) | Adj composite 3.15 vs market 2.91: gap +0.24 [MODESTLY UNDERVALUED] | +435% above the EPP floor $26.28 (12x FY15E $2.19) | Conservative 2-yr case: -57.5% total (-28.8%/yr) | At 64.1x FY15E the 15% hurdle price $185.77 sits above the BULL case; net revenue +130.2% YoY in Q2 FY15, forward revenues +34.3-38.2% (Q3 FY15 revenue guide (Q2 FY15 release (8-K/A))); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
